method: Independent physical-coordinate P1 K/C and rates; explicit sparse incidence constrained minimum via direct sparse dual solve. Full RT0 vector-field quadrature against analytic rotated-rectangle gradient. Production CG, cotangent K and recovery are not used to generate oracle values.
scope: Postprocessing verifies element-mean storage balance and normal continuity; it changes constitutive flux and does not correct the nodal temperature error. Narrow constant-property homogeneous-Dirichlet rotated rectangle, not general accuracy approval.
